excluded_effects: printf formatted output and varargs semantics

input_domain.tested: missing card resource; valid unknown-record card; one bitmap with one hotspot; one plain text frame; one styled CHITIN text frame; seeded valid card streams of 1..8 P/T records, 0..6 in-range hotspot links per P record, 1..4 text frames, 1..4 sorted style runs, text resources, variable positive rectangles, fixed valid window geometry, and explicit font fallback metrics

limits: Finite bounded differential suite; not exhaustive over all 16-bit inputs.
Only the explicitly listed logical request/fixture effects are claimed; helpers whose host callbacks replace DOS bodies are not certified for unlisted backend state.

Resource bytes and returned fixture handles/pointers/sizes are deterministic inputs in VM memory; the DOS database cache, allocator state, real lock counters, and resource lifetime enforcement are not modeled.
Font fixtures use the explicit 12px line-height and 8px character-width fallback globals with a null active font pointer; loaded proportional/fixed font tables are not tested by this DisplayCard run.

WinPrintf is a diagnostic nonsemantic sink. The primary callback observes only a call marker and does not capture formatted arguments; the focused unhooked check executes the actual one-byte DOS RETF across variable-arity call sites without claiming printf formatting semantics.

Window geometry is a fixed fixture rectangle written to the caller's VM buffer. Clip/color/bitmap/text services are compared as ordered logical requests only; clipping results, palette application, bitmap decoding, glyph masks, and framebuffer pixels are not claimed.
required_effects: ordered window, bitmap and text draw commands
